title: Adding a provider/tool/agent/stage/validator implied core edits; no generic plugin/port framework

rcca.root_cause: Extensions were hard-wired per domain module; no generic registry+adapter port and no dotted-name loader.
rcca.corrective: core/plugins.py (registry + module:callable resolver + fail-closed resolve/validate; stage/validator feed pipeline_composition, tools/agents/providers reuse existing ports); adapters live outside core; API-first.
rcca.preventive: No core edit per extension; fail-closed on unknown kind/adapter/requires; no parallel enable path; audit-clean (store registered, module wired, adapters outside core).
